traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Tubular or poroid, with fine, yellowish to olive-brown pores.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Tubular or poroid, with fine, yellowish to olive-brown pores.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: 4-10 cm in diameter. Convex, becoming more flattened with age; yellow-brown, olive-brown, or sometimes reddish-brown, often with a slightly downy or felty surface.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: 4-10 cm in diameter. Convex, becoming more flattened with age; yellow-brown, olive-brown, or sometimes reddish-brown, often with a slightly downy or felty surface.

traits.label: Hymenium attachment
traits.text: Adnate or slightly descending the stipe.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium attachment: Adnate or slightly descending the stipe.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, often with a slightly swollen base; pale yellow or yellow-brown, sometimes with a net-like (reticulated) pattern near the top.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often with a slightly swollen base; pale yellow or yellow-brown, sometimes with a net-like (reticulated) pattern near the top.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Olive-brown to brown.
traits.raw: 🟤 Olive-brown to brown.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal, associating primarily with broadleaf trees and occasionally with conifers, in woods, parks, and forests.
traits.raw: 🌳 Mycorrhizal, associating primarily with broadleaf trees and occasionally with conifers, in woods, parks, and forests.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Edible, but not highly regarded due to its somewhat bland taste.
traits.raw: 🙂 Edible, but not highly regarded due to its somewhat bland taste.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild and not distinctive.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild and not distinctive.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Stipe up to 8 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 Stipe up to 8 cm tall.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Distinguished by its velvety cap and its yellow-brownish tones. Unlike some boletes, it doesn't undergo significant color changes when bruised.
traits.raw: 🔤 Distinguished by its velvety cap and its yellow-brownish tones. Unlike some boletes, it doesn't undergo significant color changes when bruised.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are ellipsoid and smooth, 11-14 x 4-5 µm.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are ellipsoid and smooth, 11-14 x 4-5 µm.
